name: DataLabel
description: Read-only period label (`PERIOD: start - end`) with timezone-aware dates. Pure: the timezone comes in as a prop

props.name: startDate
props.description: Range start; formatted in the active timezone (`dd/MM/yy`)

props.name: endDate
props.description: Range end; formatted in the active timezone (`dd/MM/yy`)

props.name: timezone
props.description: IANA timezone the dates are shown in (e.g. `'UTC'`). Defaults to the browser's timezone; pass `useTimezone().timezone`…
props.descriptionFull: IANA timezone the dates are shown in (e.g. `'UTC'`). Defaults to the browser's timezone; pass `useTimezone().timezone` to follow the user's selected one
